c.v: This notice explains what UDVASITO collects, why, who can see it, how long we keep it and what you can do about it. We wrote it in plain words. If anything is unclear, write to us.
UDVASITO (উদ্ভাসিত) is a free blood-donor platform run by
UDVASITO — a student initiative, University of Chittagong
. It connects people who need blood with willing donors, starting in Chattogram. A team member acts as our data-protection lead.
UDVASITO is not a blood bank, a hospital or a medical service. It does not sell anything, show advertising or sell your data.

items.v: We collect only what is needed to find blood quickly and safely.
Your phone number is never public. It is shown only to the people listed under "Who can see what", and every time someone sees it, we record it.
We never store your live location or location history.
Before any text goes to an AI service, our code removes phone numbers, names and illnesses. A person always checks what the AI suggests, and AI never decides who is contacted.
You can ask for a copy of your data, correct it or delete it.

c.v: Why we may use your data (legal basis)
We process your data on the basis of

, which you give on the first screen. Donor and health-related details are covered by a separate donor consent. You can withdraw consent at any time (see "Your rights"). Bangladesh's Personal Data Protection Ordinance 2025 treats health data as sensitive, and we handle it that way.

items.v: when you type or paste a request, the text may be sent to Google's Gemini AI service to fill in the form. Our code first removes phone numbers, names, illnesses, email addresses and ID numbers. Every suggestion is marked "AI suggested" and you check it before posting. Because we use Google's free service, Google may use this cleaned text to improve its services. We keep the cleaned text and the AI's answer for
to check quality. The app works without AI.
your phone's or browser's own speech service turns your voice into text (this may be Google's service). UDVASITO never receives or stores your audio, and audio never goes to the AI service.

Data travels encrypted. Access to personal data is limited to what each role needs, and every phone-number reveal and every admin action is recorded. The practice area is kept fully separate from real requests. If a data breach puts you at risk, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.
When this notice changes, the version and date at the top change, and the app asks you to read and accept the new version before you continue.
